topic: Rear Fog Light Status and Error Reporting
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific interface or service related to the rear fog light system, detailing its status or error state.
column_semantics: Columns indicate the consumer of the service (e.g., SOA, RZCU, LHZCU) and the associated interface name and parameter details for status/error reporting.
engineering_interpretation: This table defines the status and error reporting interfaces for the rear fog light system, enabling verification of whether the rear fog light is ON, OFF, or in an unknown state, as well as checking for any faults in the system.
